executor.description: Connected third-party integrations and accounts: search for an integration tool, then invoke it by ID with JSON arguments; also lists workflow skills and stores artifacts.

browser-use.description: Drives the user's real Helium browser via the Playwright MCP extension (navigate, snapshot, click, screenshot, network/console).

computer-use.description: Desktop GUI control (screenshots, mouse, keyboard, windows, accessibility tree) on X11 display :1 via cua-driver.
